content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bhojpur at Ara, dated 19 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bhojpur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Bhojpur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Bhojpur District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bhojpur, Ara, by personally or through registered post, to reach by 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years as per Patna High Court guidelines; Stenographer needs experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing; Clerk needs knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those who retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.
